Keystone Supply Co.
Keystone Supply is a wholesale distributor of janitorial and packaging products, serving 1,200 customers from our warehouse in Columbus, Ohio. Our team of 85 people ships same day. keystone-supply.test

Open positions
Order Entry Clerk (full time). You will key customer purchase orders into Microsoft Dynamics GP and confirm ship dates by phone.

How to order
Download our PDF order form, fill it in and email it to our sales desk. We do not offer online ordering.
